skills.name: Obliterate Existence (在湮/存湮)
skills.line: Try to take off your mask now.
skills.description: SP Menreiki casts a broken mask at a single target, dealing indirect damage equal to 100% of her ATK.

skills.name: Two Faces (表里之相/表里の相)
skills.description:
Exclusive effect.
When a non-summoned entity is KO'd, their soul converges into a Void Mask. When SP Menreiki takes lethal damage, she becomes Darkened. ;Upon Usage :This skill can be activated when SP Menreiki has 4 or more Void Masks. She ignites the Watchful Eye on the inflicted enemy and becomes Darkened. ;Void Mask (未面) : :'''General, Mark''': Max 7 masks. Each mask allows her to ignore 50 DEF when attacking. ;Darknened (黒光) :'''General, Mark''': Removes the Watchful Eye, removes all debuffs from herself and changes the skill Void Dreamland to Recurrence Strike. Then she recovers 100% of her HP, her attacks will ignore 350 DEF and she gains 15% HP Steal when attacking.

upgrades.text: When Darkened, each Void Mask increases the SPD for all allies by 10.
Recurrence Strike deals an additional for each Void Mask.
If no Void Mask have been collected by the start of her next turn, she'll gain a Void Mask at the end of that turn.
After using this skill she will gain a new turn.

skills.name: Void Dreamland (梦虚空境/夢虚空境)
skills.line: I'll invite myself for a dance at the end of dreamland.
skills.description: SP Menreiki opens up a dreamland to inflict a Watchful Eye on 1 enemy with and increases the move bar for all allies by 25%. If the enemy is already inflicted with Watchful Eye, the eye is ignited before it is inflicted on them again. ; Watchful Eye (一線目) : :'''General, Mark''': Exclusive effect. Decreases the inflicted target's DEF by 20%. The effect is removed after being ignited. It will automatically ignite after 3 turns.

upgrades.text: At the start of turn, 131% of her ATK is marked as Rancor in the Watchful Eye.
20% of damage dealt by allies is marked as Rancor in the Watchful Eye.
When receiving damage, marks 30% of the damage as Rancor in the Watchful Eye.
When Watchful Eye is inflicted on the same target again, causes their passive to Suppressed, sustained until the end of her next turn and cannot be dispelled.

skills.name: Recurrence Strike (轮回一息/輪廻一息)
skills.description: SP Menreiki attack an enemy dealing indirect damage equal to 63% of her ATK. If the target is KO'd and there are still remaining strikes, they will be inflicted on the enemy with the lowest HP.

bio.condition: With SP Menreiki win 30 times in PVN zones.
